Hi Sarah — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the security review: 

Call recap:
- Scope: Veridian is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for patient-facing features; primary compliance asks are SOC 2, HIPAA controls, and identity provisioning (SSO + SCIM).
- Primary contacts: you (security), plus engineering lead for SSO test.
- Timeline: Veridian hopes to complete vendor review in ~2-3 weeks.

Requested evidence (I can coordinate delivery):
1) SOC 2 report summary / redacted report (we'll send via secure link)
2) SSO / SAML configuration docs (metadata, expected attributes, SAML flow diagram)
3) SCIM provisioning sample (CSV or test account details)
4) RBAC & admin controls documentation (defaults, role mapping, audit logs)
5) Completed vendor security questionnaire (I attached a copy for your convenience)

Next steps:
- I will share the SOC 2 redacted and SAML diagram by EOD tomorrow.
- Could you confirm if Veridian requires SP-initiated only or both SP/IdP-initiated? Also, is there a preferred attribute mapping for groups?
- We'll loop in our security SME (Marissa) for any deep-dive follow-ups; Jonas will own the SSO test coordination.

Attaching: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (blank copy for Veridian to complete). If you'd prefer, we can also set up DocuSign for the completed questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Aditya Rao

- SAML attributes: we'd like group membership passed as 'groups' and email_verified flag if available. Are those supported?
- Timeline: can you commit to sending the SOC 2 redacted + SAML metadata by tomorrow EOD (our target is to finish vendor review by Oct 18)?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks for the ping — noted. I pulled together the primary artifacts and included a short FAQ for common SSO/SCIM questions. See attachments and notes below. I can upload the SOC 2 redacted to the secure Drive link (see related_links) and trigger access to Veridian's security alias.

Attachments included: IAM-SOC2-saml-diagram.pdf, SCIM-provisioning-sample.csv

Quick answers / notes:
- SOC 2 / HIPAA: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (Security + Confidentiality). We do not have a standalone HIPAA attestation by default, but we do sign BAAs for customers with covered PHI. I'll coordinate legal; if Veridian confirms they need a BAA we can get the process started (typically 7-10 business days).

- SSO / SAML:
  - We support SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated).
  - Metadata endpoint: https://sso.redwoodinference.com/metadata.xml (we'll provide a signed metadata file).
  - Attributes supported by default: email, given_name, family_name, groups (multi-valued), email_verified (boolean).
  - Required claim for account mapping: email (case-insensitive).

- SCIM provisioning:
  - SCIM v2 supported for user and group provisioning (push only).
  - Provisioning schema follows RFC7643; sample CSV attached shows mapping used by our integration tests.
  - We log provisioning events in the audit console; sample logs can be provided under NDA if needed.

- RBAC / admin controls:
  - Roles: Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer (assignable per workspace/project).
  - Admin console audit logs: 13 months retention; exportable via API.
  - Emergency access: break-glass procedure documented and restricted to two security admins.

Next steps I will take today:
1) Upload SOC 2 redacted to secure Drive and share link with Veridian security.
2) Send signed SAML metadata file and the SAML diagram (attached).
3) Provide SCIM sample and a short provisioning checklist Jonas can use for test accounts.
4) Draft a short BAA initiation note for Legal if Sarah confirms requirement.

If you want me to join the technical call with Veridian's SREs, I can be available Thu afternoon.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
